output.evaluation_note: The English noun 'wish' (desire, aspiration), Japanese '願望' (ganbou), and Vietnamese 'nguyện vọng' are all direct and precise semantic equivalents. 'Nguyện vọng' is a common and natural Hán-Việt term in Vietnamese that perfectly captures the core meaning of a strong desire or aspiration. All three expressions align well in naturalness and register.
